name: mermaid
description: Generate Mermaid diagrams from user requirements. Supports 23+ diagram types including flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, and more.

interface.longDescription: Choose an appropriate diagram type, consult bundled Mermaid syntax and configuration references, and generate styled Mermaid code for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, database models, architecture diagrams, and more.
defaultPrompt: Use Mermaid to create a flowchart for a user login process.
Use Mermaid to draw a sequence diagram for API authentication.
